toolValid: VALID - no flag on this check. A tool can still be wrong.
watchLonger: Keep watching. A person blinks on their own schedule.
debriefHired: You approved a record that could not be verified. Evidence you never opened:
debriefHonest: Approved an honest applicant. No tell was present.
debriefWrongful: You rejected a real person. Nothing in this record was contradictory
debriefExplained: ; the flags you saw were explained in the cover letter.
debriefInsufficient: Rejected correctly, but 'insufficient evidence' is not a reason. The evidence was:

letters.plain: Dear hiring panel, I am applying for the {role} posting. I worked at {employer} from {startYear} and I would be glad to walk you through the work. My referees are available if you need them.
letters.bait: Dear panel, please consider my application. I need an answer by Friday because my situation depends on it. I know I can do the job if given the chance.
letters.flat: The applicant is submitting credentials for the {role} position. The applicant has {expYears} years of experience. The applicant possesses the required baseline competencies. The applicant requests consideration at the earliest convenience.

observationOnly: No contradiction confirmed. An observation is not evidence.
daySummaryBody: Approved {approved}, rejected {rejected}, wrongful rejections {wrongful}. Synthetics caught {caught}.
hint: Behaviour is a prompt to look closer, never a reason to reject.
manualEmpty: Nothing confirmed yet. Open a document or inspect the applicant.
quotaHintOff: The floor is short-staffed. Two desks sat empty through the shift.
quotaHintOn: Nothing unusual in the logs today.
